feature_catalog.abnormal_volume_24: Relative volume tests whether moves carry unusual participation.
feature_catalog.atr_24: Range-scaled volatility supports comparable exits across instruments.
feature_catalog.breakout_48: Distance from prior 48-hour range tests slow stop/attention cascades.
feature_catalog.btc_regime: BTC lagged daily trend conditions broad crypto risk appetite.
feature_catalog.funding: Last actually published funding rate tests crowded positioning; backward as-of joined.
feature_catalog.relative_strength_24: Alt return minus BTC return separates idiosyncratic strength.
feature_catalog.ret_24: Daily momentum captures persistent information diffusion.
feature_catalog.ret_4: Short-horizon continuation/reversal from four fully closed hourly bars.
feature_catalog.reversal_1: One-bar reversal tests temporary liquidity pressure.
feature_catalog.rv_24: Realized volatility identifies risk and forced-flow regimes.
feature_catalog.taker_imbalance_24: Aggressive flow imbalance tests persistent urgency.
feature_catalog.vwap_distance_24: Distance from trailing VWAP tests anchoring and inventory mean reversion.
